Google Messages link notices

The direct Android APK links the Go library go.mau.fi/mautrix-gmessages v0.2610.1-0.20261103213626-d9140a5e807e (libgm) under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later. Its private safety patch is apps/android/googlemessages/upstream-safety.patch.

Corresponding source

The release-tagged public Peppy repository provides the app source, the in-repository private patch, and the Go module needed to rebuild the direct Android APK with a modified library. A modifier rebuilds from that release-tagged repository and signs the resulting APK with their own signing key.

Linked into the direct Android native library
